content: Official UEFA sources confirm a 36-club single league table with eight matches per club: ranks 1-8 reach the round of 16, 9-24 enter two-legged knockout play-offs, and 25-36 are eliminated. Knockout pairings are rank-constrained (9/10 vs 23/24, 11/12 vs 21/22, 13/14 vs 19/20, 15/16 vs 17/18) and later rounds follow a bracket whose paths and second-leg advantages depend on league-phase ranking.
